rules.statement: Give each generated shot one subject, one subtle environmental action, and one camera move to protect continuity and readability.
Let movement come from daylight, sheer fabric, foliage, water, a hand interaction, or a deliberate camera drift; keep furniture and architecture stable.
Do not synthesize logos, typography, interface, prices, or offers in footage. Composite verified copy and identity separately.
Reject any shot where a real product changes shape, finish, scale, hardware, orientation, or number of parts within or between frames.
Only upload visual references when their rights record explicitly permits model input; otherwise translate observations into non-identifying semantic direction.

promptStructure: A collected, livable {roomState} anchored by {heroFurnishing}.
Soft directional daylight enters from {lightDirection}; only curtains, foliage, flame, or water move subtly.
The camera performs one {cameraMove} over {duration} seconds at natural eye level with controlled verticals.
Preserve furniture placement, room geometry, materials, scale, and color for the entire shot.
No people looking at camera, object morphing, sliding furniture, fake text, logo, or rapid movement.
composition.cameraIntent: Measured observation, no more than one axis of travel.
continuityChecks: first and last frame geometry match

promptStructure: Close material study of {materialOrCraftDetail} with true texture and construction.
Soft raking light reveals surface relief while {subtleAction} provides minimal natural motion.
Use a nearly locked frame or restrained {cameraMove} for {duration} seconds.
Maintain exact material, joinery, hardware, and color without shimmer, melting, excess blur, or invented details.
No text or logo.

inputSlots.reference: Authorized start image containing the verified product and approved scene.

promptStructure: Animate the supplied start image as one continuous, photorealistic shot. The product and room are locked identity references, not redesign suggestions.
Only {subjectAction} and {environmentalMotion} may move.
Perform one slow {cameraMove} over {cameraDistance} for {duration} seconds at natural eye level.
Preserve product silhouette, finish, materials, hardware, seams, countable features, scale, contact, room geometry, object placement, and light direction in every frame.
End with {finalHold} seconds of visually calm footage for a separately composited brand resolve.
No transformation, invented variant, texture crawl, melting water, sliding object, warping architecture, speed ramp, text, logo, or claim.
continuityChecks: first and last frame geometry agree
composition.failureAction: Reject the whole shot on any identity or geometry drift; do not hide the defect with a transition.

promptStructure: An inviting {outdoorSetting} composed as an open-air room around {heroFurnishing}.
Use soft {weather} light with natural foliage or water movement and tactile stone, woven fiber, linen, and weathered wood.
The camera makes one gentle {cameraMove} for {duration} seconds.
Architecture, furniture, cushions, tableware, and shadows remain stable.
No resort clichés, crowds, dramatic weather, text, logo, or object morphing.

composition.footage: Generate or select only the clean visual plate.
composition.composite: Add official logo and verified typography as controlled layers after footage creation.
composition.hold: Keep the final readable composition on screen for at least 1.2 seconds.

evaluation.question: Are geometry, materials, product identity, lighting, shadows, and object positions stable from first to last frame?
Is there one restrained camera intent without acceleration, drift, or distortion that distracts from the design?
Does the footage feel collected, tactile, naturally lit, and livable rather than synthetic or generic luxury?
Are all words, offers, and brand marks verified and added separately from generated footage?
